The '''Harbinger courier ship''' was a model of courier ship in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in its first [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of existence.

==History==
The [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Strikefast/Legends|''Strikefast'']] carried at least one of the ships when it made contact with [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]].
